fieldValues.title: CLAUDE.md stated dataModelRevision 5 while the manifest was at 7
fieldValues.summary: The monorepo CLAUDE.md described the corpus as dataModelRevision 5 and enumerated the generations up to that point. The live manifest was at 7. An agent trusting the guidance would classify a rev-6 or rev-7 corpus as newer than anything it supports, or fetch a binary two generations behind. Corrected separately in PR #621 rather than folded into the RFC.
evidence: CLAUDE.md's data-model paragraph enumerated revisions 1 through 5
Correction filed as the-greenman/srs#621, separate from the RFC PR #620
fieldValues.body: Same class as the stale counts, one layer up: the guidance document is a second home for a value the manifest already carries, and the second home went stale. The lasting fix is not to restate a manifest field in prose at all; the immediate one was to correct it and keep the correction out of the RFC's diff so neither PR's review has to carry the other's subject.
